method: Three rounds. Each round a fresh agent that had never seen the designs matched shuffled, unlabeled black silhouettes in 6 views (side, front, 3/4 front, 3/4 rear, top, traffic ahead at 14 m) to the 12 class names, with a confidence of 1-3. Designs were revised between rounds; round 3 is the final design.
summary: Named correctly: 72 of 72 in every round (12 cars x 6 views).
Named and "sure": 33 -> 36 -> 39 of 72 as the designs were revised.
Final design, sure per view: side 12/12, 3/4 front 8/12, 3/4 rear 8/12, front 5/12, traffic ahead 5/12, top 1/12.
From the top every car is a rounded rectangle; identity from above comes from the roof graphic (glass, light bar, bed, livery), not the outline.
